summary: Alterity Therapeutics Ltd filed a Form 6-K for June 2026, incorporating by reference into its existing F-3 and S-8 registration statements. The sole substantive exhibit is a notification regarding unquoted securities (Exhibit 99.1, a graphic). No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or abrupt management change is disclosed. The filing is a routine foreign private issuer report with no special-situation event.
